caption: The drawing consists of two main pencil sketches on a beige background. At the top center, there is a circular object with a raised, stylized three-petal or leaf-like motif in the middle, surrounded by a border decorated with a triangular pattern. Below this, near the center of the page, there is a simple side view outline of a two-part pedestal or base. The upper part of the pedestal features vertical, slightly wavy lines, and it sits upon a wider rectangular base. Below this structure, horizontal lines and small numerical divisions indicate a scale measured in inches, with numbers ranging from 0 to 3. The lines and shading are done in gray pencil and are lightly rendered, with more detail and shading concentrated on the circular object at the top. The background is plain and uncolored, with no extraneous markings apart from the main objects and the scale.
title: Butter Mold
